title: Incrementalist Configuration
description: JSON schema for Incrementalist configuration file (incrementalist.json)

solutionFilePath.description: The name of the Solution file to be analyzed by Incrementalist.

outputFile.description: If specified, writes the output to the named file.

listFolders.description: List affected folders instead of .NET projects.

gitBranch.description: The git branch to compare against. i.e. the 'dev' or the 'master' branch.

workingDirectory.description: Specify the working directory explicitly. Defaults to using the current working directory.

verbose.description: Prints out extensive debug logs during operation.

timeoutMinutes.description: Specifies the load timeout for the solution in whole minutes. Defaults to 2 minutes.

continueOnError.description: When running commands, continue executing even if some commands fail.

runInParallel.description: When running commands, execute them in parallel.

failOnNoProjects.description: When running commands, fail if no projects are affected.

noCache.description: Ignore any existing cache file and perform a full Roslyn analysis.

skip.description: Glob patterns to exclude projects from the final list. Applied after analyzing dependencies.

target.description: Glob patterns to include only matching projects in the final list. Applied after analyzing dependencies.

nameApplicationToStart.description: The application or document to start the process.
